title: delphinium hirticaule var. coelestinum
intro: Delphinium hirticaule var. coelestinum, commonly known as the Coelestina delphinium or Coelestina, is a plant species in the Delphinium genus, known for its tall spikes of blue or white flowers. It has been found to have various health benefits, including anti-inflammatory, antioxidant, and antimicrobial properties. The therapeutic actions of Coelestina include being used to treat fever, rheumatism, and respiratory issues, as well as having a sedative and antispasmodic effect. The bioactive constituents of Coelestina include alkaloids, flavonoids, and phenolic compounds, which are believed to contribute to its medicinal properties.
